metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-sq[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Memory webs and strands[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A keyed memory collection is a first-class SASE memory kind: one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]flat web descriptor note plus a sibling directory of strand files, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]configured by users adding files, rendered as core or reference [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]memory per web, and read with `sase memory read <web>:<keyword>`. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]The glossary, task types, and a new decision log all run on that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one substrate, and the config-backed glossary is gone.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]memory_webs.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Core and reference memory vocabulary[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]tiers[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]tiers: rename short-term/long-term memory to core/reference across the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rust tier wire, note frontmatter, AGENTS.md anchors, templates, skills, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]docs, and prose, accepting the old spelling forever and migrating [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing notes in place.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Web and strand substrate[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]substrate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after tiers[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]substrate: add the web/strand domain model, provider-based discovery, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the fail-closed validator, managed roster regions, and core/reference [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]web rendering behind the memory_webs beta flag.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Selector-based memory read and the web command group[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after substrate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: make `sase memory read`/`show` variadic over note, web, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]web:keyword selectors, add `sase memory web list|show`, and unify the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]read audit event around a note/web/strand kind discriminator.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]ACE memory pane webs and strands[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]ace[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ace: teach the ACE memory pane to browse webs and their strands, preview[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]strand bodies, and reuse the existing memory read audit path.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision web and flag removal[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]decisions[dim] · [dim][/dim]after cli, ace[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]decisions: remove the memory_webs beta flag and close its flag bead, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]then ship the `decisions` core web with six authored decision records.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Generated task-type web[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]task_types[dim] · [dim][/dim]after decisions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]task_types: add the generated web provider driven by the task-type [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]registry and convert the task_types core note into a generated core web [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with one strand per agent-creatable type.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Glossary migration to a core web[/bold #D7AFFF]                              [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]glossary[dim] · [dim][/dim]after decisions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]glossary: generalize the Rust glossary source wire to file-backed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]strands, add the one-shot config-to-strand migration, fail closed on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dual truth, and migrate the sase and bob-cli glossaries.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Retire the config glossary[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]retire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after task_types, glossary[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retire: delete the config-backed glossary package, schema, completion [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]source, and CLI group, fold the ACE glossary pane into the memory pane, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and finish the docs.[/#D7D7AF]
